name: URTC-TESTER
build: Standalone Python desktop tool. pip install -r requirements.txt; Qt Quick diagnostics deck is started with --qtquick.
notes: Real live CAN-bus diagnostic tool including CSV export of live graphs. Qt Quick is a staged, safety-first connection and identity-probe deck; the established Tkinter UI remains default until 25-tool control parity is complete. advanced_protocol.py's protocol boundary (bounded_int/motion_frame/drill_frame, plus the same class of bug independently duplicated in qt_tester.py and tester_tool_panels.py) now strictly rejects an out-of-range or unrecognized-direction value instead of silently clamping/re-interpreting it as a different valid command.
